translation.question: เพลงใดถูกนำมาแสดงในช่วง Liberté ของพิธีเปิดการแข่งขันกีฬาโอลิมปิกฤดูร้อน 2024
translation.translation_note: Kept 'Liberté' and 'Ah! ca ira!' in Latin script as they are proper nouns (sequence name and French song title) commonly used in Thai media coverage of the event.

backtranslation_en.question: Which song was performed during the Liberté segment of the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony?
